title: Underived localized tensor comparison coherence
statement: For schemes X and X′, k : X′ ⟶ X, opens U of X and U′ of X′, j : U′.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme, hj : j ≫ U.ι = U′.ι ≫ k, and any homotopy complex P of O_X-modules, the target homotopy comparison followed by the homotopy tensor restriction comparison equals eqToHom of the inverse of congrArg (f ↦ ((tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) hj followed by the source homotopy comparison. Additivity of all tensor pullbacks and shared derived-category localizations are assumed, as required by the definitions. The restriction comparison is [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso]; the source and target homotopy comparisons are the definitions in [lem-pc-open-pinned-source-counit-triangle] and [lem-pc-open-pinned-target-counit-triangle], respectively. No derived counit or derived composition is involved.

proof.text:
expand the restriction comparison into its four factors: the inverse
open comparison for U', the inverse target composition comparison, the source
composition comparison along hj, and the open comparison for U. The target
homotopy comparison is the inverse of the lift of the first two factors, so
these cancel. The last two factors are the source comparison. For an arbitrary
morphism f and an equality j ≫ U.ι = f, equality induction identifies the
composition comparison along that equality with the comparison at j ≫ U.ι
precomposed by equality transport. This induction generalizes f first, rather
than trying to eliminate the equality of two fixed composites. Apply this at
hj. Lifting additive functors to complexes and then to the homotopy quotient
preserves composition, inverses, and equality transport, giving the displayed
identity for every P. This argument uses only functor identities; it applies to
empty and top opens and zero complexes without any extra hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Four constructed comparison factors, equality induction, and functorial lifting to homotopy categories; fully checked in Lean.

lean.statement: theorem open_pinned_tensor_comparison_coherence {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme) (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k) (P : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) : (openPinnedHomotopyTargetCompositionIso k U').hom.app P ≫ (openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso k U U' j hj).hom.app P = eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) hj).symm ≫ (openPinnedHomotopySourceCompositionIso U j).hom.app P
